json.take: The alternative pass looks tidy in theory, but a simulation cannot easily account for the defender's body orientation or the friction of a real-time touch when Sacha Tolliver already has a clear sight of the net. Second-guessing an actual goal with a short-horizon model hides the risk of a turnover on that extra pass, so taking the shot on the transition is the right call.
